ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray pixels occupy approximately 70% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels concentrated at the peduncle junction and along the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity contiguous blocks across the central and distal regions of both lobes. Low-intensity dark-gray mottling is concentrated at the proximal peduncle junction and extends in thin, linear streaks and focal clusters toward the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; the depth of the notch extends significantly into the fluke's vertical midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularity. The right lobe trailing edge contains a significant jagged excision (depth ~5% of lobe width). The left lobe trailing edge displays continuous, fine-grain serration with smaller-scale valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from notch to mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex curve as the edge reaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized detection of small, circular dark pixel clusters on the high-intensity white background of the right lobe; light-colored circular rosette scarring is visible within the dark pigmentation near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the high-intensity regions of both lobes, appearing as distinct unaligned scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tearing and trailing-edge loss on the medial section of the right lobe. Pervasive linear rake mark scarring covering approximately 40% of the visible ventral area.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined circular scar with a high-contrast dark rim and light center is positioned on the right lobe, adjacent to the central notch.
